title: Luke Surveys All
description: Luke Surveys All from atop his trusty tauntaun in this unattributed poster concept (front) for THE EMPIRE STRIKES BACK. Though quite different in appearance from the Style A poster by Roger Kastel (card 67), it contains many of the same elements, including the tender embrace of Han and Leia. The British quad poster concept (back) uses many Ralph McQuarrie elements.
